import os
import psycopg
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()
conn = psycopg.connect(os.environ['DATABASE_URL'])

rows = conn.execute('SELECT id, body FROM documents').fetchall()
for doc_id, body in rows:
    emb = client.embeddings.create(model='text-embedding-3-large', input=body)
    conn.execute('UPDATE documents SET embedding = %s WHERE id = %s', (emb.data[0].embedding, doc_id))
conn.commit()

import json, anthropic
client = anthropic.Anthropic()
with open('exports/tickets.jsonl') as f:
    for line in f:
        t = json.loads(line)
        client.messages.create(model='claude-haiku', max_tokens=300, messages=[{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Summarize: ' + t['body']}])

import requests
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI()
url = 'https://support.example.com/api/tickets'
while url:
    page = requests.get(url).json()
    for t in page['tickets']:
        client.responses.create(model='gpt-5-mini', input='Summarize: ' + t['body'])
    url = page.get('next')
